desc: Implement NTT (Number Theoretic Transform) for convolution under mod 998244353.
Compute digit lengths for numbers 1..N and group by length d=1..6, storing counts cnt[d] and sum_v[d] of numbers with that length.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo 998244353 up to N.
For each d with cnt[d] > 0, build polynomial (1 + 10^d * x)^{cnt[d]} using binomial coefficients, truncated to degree N.
Multiply all such polynomials together using NTT to obtain P(x) truncated to degree N.
For each d, compute Q_d(x) via recurrence Q_d[k] = P[k] - 10^d * Q_d[k-1] for k=1..N-1.
Compute S_d = sum_{k=0}^{N-1} k! (N-1-k)! * Q_d[k] mod p.
Accumulate answer as sum_d sum_v[d] * S_d mod p and output.
Test the solution on the provided sample inputs (N=3, N=390, N=79223) and additional edge cases to verify correctness and performance.
